description: MariaDB is a table database with many roots shared with MySQL. This course uses its own client and features. Learn a small table, grouped text, safe updates and a practice backup in a separate database. Use MariaDB 10.11+ with its mariadb client in an empty practice database. These dialect-specific examples do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Keep the sample database separate from real records.
versionNote: Uses MariaDB 10.11+ SQL and the mariadb-dump client.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to explain why the title column uses NOT NULL
Learn to change the ordering to longest books first
Learn to explain why only one Mia row remains
learningObjectives: Learn to explain why the title column uses NOT NULL
